name: Tab session presence
responsibility: Knows which browser tab each chat on screen belongs to, which checkout's conversation the tab shows, and ends a tab session when no chat of it comes back within 60 seconds
description: It lives as long as the server process, not as long as one child. A chat of the tab that comes back within the grace cancels the end, so a reload keeps the conversation. A tab that shows no checkout yet is pinned on the first read to the checkout the asker names, and only the person's own act in the page changes it, through the host's activation. In Archboard the pin is the checkout of the tab's focused pane, else of the pane that asked, and an agent's browser show never moves it, so the dock never moves while somebody types. It ends with the tab.

outgoing.label: end a tab no chat came back to in 60 s
the shown conversation changed: present the chats again
